title: Cold Weather Myth Busted

scenes.text: Why does a 3°C breeze never give you a cold?
Many believe stepping outside in chilly air makes you catch a cold.
scenes.label: Cold air causes colds

scenes.text: Colds are caused by rhinoviruses; temperature alone doesn't transmit the virus.
scenes.label: Viruses, not temperature
Hand hygiene wins
scenes.sub: Clean hands stop the virus, not the chill.

scenes.text: Follow so you never run out of fun facts.

description: Think the cold makes you sick? The truth is far cooler. Learn the real reason behind colds and protect yourself the right way. Follow for more mind‑blowing fact checks!
